correctness.rationale: Strict Clarkson sign for real p unequal to 2 forces pairwise disjoint supports of all unit columns. The one-spare-row condition permits only singleton supports or one doubled support, yielding unique open intervals glued at signed-injection vertices; compact-Hausdorff bijection verifies topology. Exact V/E counts, all-row-blank swap connectivity including independent sign flips, and Euler characteristic prove graph homotopy and H1. Entrywise power gives p-independence. A fresh executable finite enumeration passed n=2..6 and 45,280 supplementary norm checks; these tests are not the infinite proof.
